title: Pure Red Dragon Archfiend
summary: Pure Red Dragon Archfiend build driven by Resonators and cards that support Jack Atlas's signature Dragon, backed by generic staples. Every combo line ascends through DARK Dragon Synchro Monsters to build multi-layered negates and board wipes under strict Extra Deck locks.

summary.title: Starters
points: Soul Resonator adds a Level 4 or lower Fiend monster like Bone Archfiend from the Deck on summon, and banishes itself from the GY to protect your cards from destruction while you control Red Dragon Archfiend.
Bone Archfiend sends a card from hand or field to summon itself from the hand or GY, then mills a Fiend Tuner from the Deck to adjust a monster's Level by 1.
Power Vice Dragon summons itself from the hand if you control no monsters or only DARK Synchros, searches any Resonator, and grants battle destruction immunity to a Red Dragon Archfiend made with it.
Darkness Resonator reveals Red Dragon Archfiend in the Extra Deck to summon itself, grants an extra Normal Summon of a Resonator, and can modulate your Tuners to Level 1.
Crimson Gaia adds Red Dragon Archfiend or a card that mentions it from the Deck or GY to hand, and revives Red Dragon Archfiend if a card on the field is destroyed.

summary.title: Opening: Soul Resonator + Any Discard
steps: Normal Summon Soul Resonator and search Bone Archfiend from the Deck.
Activate Bone Archfiend in hand, sending any card to the GY to Special Summon itself.
Activate Bone Archfiend's effect targeting itself: send Crimson Resonator from the Deck to the GY to reduce Bone Archfiend's Level to 3.
Synchro Summon Red Rising Dragon (Level 6) using Level 3 Soul Resonator and Level 3 Bone Archfiend, and activate its effect to revive Crimson Resonator.

Synchro Summon Scarred Dragon Archfiend (Level 8) using Red Rising Dragon and Crimson Resonator, then use Crimson Resonator's GY effect or Scarred's float to climb into Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss, Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Bane, or Red Supernova Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss targets and negates the effects of any face-up card on the field as a Quick Effect.
Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Bane tributes a monster to revive any Red Dragon Archfiend monster from the GY, and revives two Tuners from the GY when it inflicts battle damage.
Red Supernova Dragon and Red Hypernova Dragon require multiple Tuners to unleash devastating field-wide banishing effects and impervious protection.

Scarred Dragon Archfiend counts as Red Dragon Archfiend on the field and in the GY, and when sent from the Monster Zone to the GY, it Special Summons Red Dragon Archfiend from the Extra Deck and destroys all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.
The Crimson King searches support on summon and can banish itself when the opponent activates a monster effect to Special Summon Red Dragon Archfiend with doubled ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Red Zone destroys a card on the field as a Quick Effect when the opponent activates a card or effect while you control Red Dragon Archfiend, and targets a banished DARK Dragon Synchro to Special Summon it.

Champion's Pulse Special Summons Red Dragon Archfiend or Hot Red Dragon Archfiend from the Extra Deck or GY when the opponent activates a monster effect while controlling more cards, negating and destroying that monster.
Crimson Call searches a Level 4 or lower Fiend while you control Red Dragon Archfiend and can banish itself from the GY to grant a second attack.

King's Resonance revives a DARK Synchro Monster if your opponent Special Summoned this turn, granting Red Dragon Archfiend immunity to opponent's activated effects or flipping their monsters face-down.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The pure build omits the Bystial engine (such as Bystial Lubellion and Magnamhut) and Branded Fusion engines seen on tournament lists, keeping the focus entirely on Resonators and pure DARK Dragon Synchro climbing.

allow.Power Vice Dragon: 2026 support that names Red Dragon Archfiend and searches Resonators.
allow.Bone Archfiend: Red Dragon Archfiend support from the Crimson set: its lock only allows DARK Dragon Synchros.
